raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 5012 rows but only 4866 distinct txn_ids, so some transactions were delivered more than once across ingest batches. silver_transactions keeps every POSTED copy, which creates 137 duplicate keys and inflates every gold count and total. Fix: keep one row per txn_id, choosing the most recently ingested copy. This assumes the duplicate copies are identical re-deliveries or that the latest delivery should win; the duplicate rows themselves are not shown.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1"}}
